card.name: First digits of a book's ISBN
card.fires_on: A single digit right after the first hyphen (or first digits) of an ISBN in a book citation. It marks the publisher-code start, such as 8, 6 or 5.

modes.label: Publisher digit after ISBN 0-
modes.description: The first digit of the publisher part after "ISBN 0-" in a bibliography entry.
modes.example: American Abolitionism: Fighting Slavery in the Early Republic. Univ of North Carolina Press, 2002. ISBN 0-<<8>>078

modes.label: Digit after 978-0-
modes.description: The publisher digit in a 13-digit ISBN starting 978-0-.

card.plain: It lights up on the digit that begins the publisher section of a book's ISBN number in a reference list.
